texts.local: Use this when TallyPrime is on this computer, or you don't have a server. Bills and stock are saved on this computer. Phones and other counters on the same Wi-Fi can open Dukaan too.
texts.remote: Use this when Dukaan already runs on your server (for example Unraid). This computer becomes a billing counter.
texts.remoteHint: The address you open Dukaan with in the browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2510 or https://pos.yourdomain.com
